title: MCP++ A2A Activation@1
description: Client activation of the MCP++ A2A execution extension via the A2A-Extensions service parameter. Each entry MUST be a URI; reverse-DNS-only tokens are non-conformant. Interface: A2AExtensionSchema@1. Normative prose: a2a-extension.md §2.1–§2.2, §4.2.
$comment: Schema marker: mcp++/a2a/activation@1. Models the parsed activation list, not the raw comma-separated header string.

a2a_extensions.description: Parsed A2A-Extensions entries the client intends to activate. MUST include the MCP++ execution URI to activate this extension.

mcp_plus_plus_execution_activated.description: True when https://mcplusplus.io/extensions/execution/v1 is present in a2a_extensions.

echo_on_response.description: When true, agent response SHOULD echo activated URIs in A2A-Extensions.

extensionUriEntry.description: Absolute URI identifying an A2A extension. Reverse-DNS tokens without a URI scheme are invalid.
